classifications.rationale: The President directs the Attorney General to initiate judicial proceedings by filing a petition. The segment does not itself enjoin the strike, nor does it dictate that the court grant relief; any legal consequence occurs later through judicial action, and the additional relief sought remains subject to the Attorney General's judgment.
classifications.evidence: I direct you, pursuant to the Provisions of Section 208 of the Labor Management Relations Act, 1947, to petition in the name of the United States
